get.summary: GET /api/youtube/title?url=... — Fetch video title via YouTube oEmbed.
get.description:
Lightweight proxy to avoid CORS issues. Returns `{ title, author }`.
Used by the frontend to auto-fill the source title on paste.

Performs a lightweight DB check (`SELECT 1`) and returns 200 if healthy,
503 if the database is unreachable (e.g., pool exhaustion).

503.description: One or more dependencies are unhealthy

get.description:
Returns comprehensive health status including database connectivity,
external client circuit breaker states and metrics, purge task status,
and SSE broadcaster information.

Returns 200 if healthy, 503 if degraded, 401 if token is required but missing/wrong.
Does NOT expose secrets or user data.

When `HEALTH_TOKEN` is set in config, requests must include `X-Health-Token` header
with the matching value. When unset, access is unrestricted (backwards compatible).

200.description: Per-dependency health, pool metrics and circuit-breaker state

503.description: One or more dependencies are unhealthy

ChatChunk.description: A partial text delta from the provider.

ChatCitationRef.description: An inline `[N]` citation marker, emitted after final evidence validation.

ChatCitations.description: The resolved citation set for the whole answer.

ChatDone.description:
Terminal success payload.

`rag_log_id` is `null` when the answer used no retrieved context, so no RAG
log row exists to link feedback to.

oneOf.description: Text delta. Emitted zero or more times.

data.description: Text delta. Emitted zero or more times.

ChatEvent.description:
Every event the chat stream can emit, in `v1` of the protocol.

Clients must ignore unknown variants without terminating the stream:
additive variants are not a breaking change.

ChatMessageResponse.description:
Chat message response DTO.

Lives in the service layer (not API) because it's shared by both
the API handlers and the export service.

ChatMetrics.description:
Retrieval quality metrics for this exchange.

`context_relevance` is `null` when the answer used no retrieved context.

ChatShutdown.description:
Terminal payload emitted when graceful shutdown interrupts a live stream.

Distinct from [`ChatError`] so the client can offer a retry instead of
reporting a provider failure.

oneOf.description: History was cut to fit the token budget; `kept` messages survived.
Dropped history is being summarized into memory.

ChatSystem.description: Server-side notices about how the prompt was assembled.

ClientHealth.description: Health status for a single external client.

ClientMetricsHealth.description: Subset of client metrics exposed in the health endpoint.

CreateSourceRequest.description: Request for creating a source via JSON.

DatabaseHealth.description: Database health status including pool configuration and live metrics.

DetailedHealthResponse.description: Detailed health response with comprehensive diagnostics.

EmbeddingProgress.description: Embedding progress for real-time UI updates.

HealthResponse.description: Basic health response for load balancer checks.

MemoriesListResponse.description: Response for listing notebook memories with plan usage info.

MemoryResponse.description: A single memory in the API response.

PoolMetrics.description: Live database connection pool metrics from the underlying sqlx pool.

active_connections.description: Total connections currently managed by the pool (active + idle).

idle_connections.description: Connections currently idle and available for use.

max_connections.description: Maximum connections the pool is configured to hold.

utilization_pct.description: Pool utilization as a percentage: `(active - idle) / max * 100`.

PurgeTaskHealth.description: Health status for a periodic purge task.

SendMessageRequest.description: Request for sending a chat message.

locale.description: UI locale for generating suggestions in the correct language (e.g. "fr", "en")

degraded_services.description:
Services that were unavailable during processing (e.g., "contextualization").
Empty when all services operated normally.

oneOf.description: OCR extraction has started for a PDF source.

data.description: OCR extraction has started for a PDF source.

oneOf.description: OCR result served from cache — no API call needed.

data.description: OCR result served from cache — no API call needed.

oneOf.description:
The replay buffer could not satisfy `Last-Event-ID`, or the subscriber
lagged behind the broadcast channel. `missed` events were lost and the
client must refetch the source list to resynchronize.

Produced at the transport edge, never broadcast: it is per-subscriber.

data.description:
The replay buffer could not satisfy `Last-Event-ID`, or the subscriber
lagged behind the broadcast channel. `missed` events were lost and the
client must refetch the source list to resynchronize.

Produced at the transport edge, never broadcast: it is per-subscriber.

SourceEvent.description:
Events emitted during source processing.

Clients must ignore unknown variants without terminating the stream.

SourceStatusData.description: Data for source status change events (boxed to reduce enum size disparity).

ThinkingStage.description: Progress stage of the pipeline, for the client's thinking indicator.

UserFeedback.description: User feedback on a RAG response.

WarningKind.description:
Non-fatal conditions the client localizes and renders.

A closed discriminator rather than free text: the message is the client's
to translate.

YouTubeTitleResponse.description: Response for the YouTube title lookup.

bearer_auth.description: Bearer token verified by the composed identity adapter.
